facts.fact: The ANEC director-general's presentation of August 2025 gives ANEC, under the ministry of Urbanisme, Collectivités territoriales et Aménagement des Territoires, the missions of progressively computerising the management of civil-status centres and centralising civil-status data, with communes registering the events.
facts.system: RNEC / application de gestion des faits d'état civil (LGEC)

facts.fact: The ANEC presentation of August 2025 lists as still ahead the financing of the national civil-status strategy, the financing of NEKKAL 2 and the strengthening of ANEC's financial capacity, and names no budget line or funder for the system.
facts.system: RNEC / application de gestion des faits d'état civil (LGEC)

facts.fact: ANEC states that the management software is given to agents and officers of civil-status centres for registering and issuing acts, and that declarations registered via the national register RNEC numbered 112,881 in 2024 and 108,233 from 1 January to 3 July 2025.
facts.system: RNEC / application de gestion des faits d'état civil (LGEC)

facts.fact: ANEC states that 235 civil-status centres are in service (connected to the network and operational) and 383 installed with network equipment, against 400 centres in which the application is being put in place; it gives no total of centres and no date for the counts, so the presentation's date of August 2025 is used.
facts.system: RNEC / application de gestion des faits d'état civil (LGEC)
